Capability manifest for (the .pc-navmenu container) — svelte-pure-admin. See layout.map.json / footer.map.json for the model. NavMenu.svelte renders
    {children}
; with `collapse` set it adds data-pc-fit-nav* and attaches the core Fit engine at onMount (NO id — binds via bind:this), so collapse is capability-only (not strict-compared). Items come from NavItem/NavDropdown sub-components (container-only). Shared SSR features: the items slot, the collapse capability (menu|sidebar), the root class passthrough.
